unrepresented.why: br-ai-nstorm relations and conflicts live inside one problem; Postack records relate problems to each other.

unrepresented.what: The record writer’s own text (approaches, open questions, indexing notes)
unrepresented.why: authoredBy may never be an AI, so agent-written text cannot enter as contributions. It stays in the Postack record.

mismatches.contract: Repository adoption imports Markdown files named in brainstorm.config.json (docs/ADOPTION.md §3).
mismatches.reality: Most of the knowledge is in issues and pull-request conversations, which are not files.
mismatches.adapter: A separate adapter feeds the same event model. The manifest and Markdown extractor are not used.

mismatches.reality: 221 GitHub accounts wrote this material; the repository is one of them.
mismatches.adapter: authoredBy is github:<login> for threads and comments, repo:<owner/name> only for documents.

mismatches.contract: SourceRef has path, startLine and endLine.
mismatches.reality: A comment has a URL and an id, no file and no lines.
mismatches.adapter: path is issues/<n>#issuecomment-<id>, lines are 0; the URL is kept. The static view therefore prints #L0.

mismatches.contract: A unit is the full paragraph or list item, quoted for reading.
mismatches.reality: Comment text belongs to its author and is not committed here.
mismatches.adapter: Content is the record’s verbatim excerpt (≤25 words), or the thread title when only metadata is cited.

mismatches.contract: Nothing relational is derived on import; relations come from participants and curation.
mismatches.reality: GitHub authors link threads (“#113 reports your exact symptom”). That link is the author’s own statement.
mismatches.adapter: Linked pairs become pending proposals by importer:github-links onBehalfOf the author, never accepted relations.

mismatches.contract: Provenance.timestamp is when a contribution entered shared memory.
mismatches.reality: The order people said things in is the story of a thread.
mismatches.adapter: Events carry the snapshot time; the original time travels in Postack’s source metadata, not in the event.

mismatches.contract: An imported unit’s kind comes from the author’s section heading; otherwise the lexical classifier.
mismatches.adapter: Kind is br-ai-nstorm’s own inferKind(content); the record writer’s reading is a classification proposal.
